data.name: Dhikrul
data.gender_notes: Dhikrul is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dhikrul is derived from the Arabic word 'dhikr' which means remembrance, commemoration, or reminder. In Islamic context, it is the act of frequently remembering and glorifying Allah (SWT). The name Dhikrul carries the meaning “Remembrance of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dhikrul usually hope their child will grow to embody remembrance of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A constant reminder of Allah's presence and guidance.
data.etymology: Dhikrul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Remembrance of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhikrul total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: ذكرول
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مذكر مشتق من ذكر، يعني التذكير بالله تعالى وعبادته، وورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: ﴿وإذا ذكر الله وحده اشمأزت قلوبهم﴾، ويعتبر من الأسماء ذات المعنى العميق في التراث الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: ذکرول
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام ذکر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی یاد اور عبادت۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے مابین مقبول ہے اور اسلامی تقالید میں اس کا گہرا مطلب ہے۔

in_hindi.name: धिरकुल
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम 'धिरक' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है भगवान की याद और पूजा। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग होता है और इसका अर्थ गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: ذکرول
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا نوم د ذکر څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د الله یاد او عبادت ده. دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانانو تر منځ مشهور دی او په اسلامي دود کې يې ژور مفهوم دی.

in_english.name: Dhikrul
in_english.meaning: Remembrance of Allah, devotion to Him

Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing a deep spiritual connection and commitment to faith.
